parameters.name: BasePath
parameters.description: The root path of the API.

parameters.name: CompatibleFlags
parameters.description: A list of associated tags. Separate multiple tags with commas (,).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the API group. The description can be up to 180 characters in length. If you do not specify this parameter, the description is not modified.

parameters.name: FilterAppCodeForBackend
parameters.description: Specifies whether to filter the app code from backend requests.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and is globally unique.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the API group. The name must be unique and 4 to 50 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and Chinese characters. If you do not specify this parameter, the name is not modified.

parameters.name: SupportSSE
parameters.description: Specifies whether the gateway sends event streams to clients to enable real-time data push.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The object tags to which the rule applies. You can specify multiple tags.
